=== FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "IRQ-PARAM", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "1. Parameters", "text": "The block works for every `N` from 2 to 32, and bits `N` and up of the `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` registers read as zero and ignore writes."},
    {"id": "IRQ-RESET", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` clear to zero and the remembered level of every source clears to zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-REG-RW", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "text": "A write to `ENABLE` or `MODE` stores `wdata` bits `N-1` to 0 in that register."},
    {"id": "IRQ-READ", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LEVEL", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.2 Detection", "text": "A high-level source sets its `PENDING` bit at every rising edge where its input is high."},
    {"id": "IRQ-EDGE", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.2 Detection", "text": "A rising-edge source sets its `PENDING` bit at a rising edge where its input is high and was low at the previous rising edge, so an input held high sets it once."},
    {"id": "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.2 Detection", "text": "Detection does not depend on `ENABLE`: a disabled source still sets its `PENDING` bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-W1C", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "text": "A write to `PENDING` clears each bit written 1 and leaves each bit written 0 unchanged; it never sets a bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-ACK", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "text": "A write to `CLAIM` acknowledges the source whose number is in `wdata` bits 4 to 0: that source's `PENDING` bit clears and no other bit changes; a number of `N` or more changes nothing."},
    {"id": "IRQ-SET-WINS", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "text": "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."},
    {"id": "IRQ-MASK", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when some source has both its `PENDING` and its `ENABLE` bit set, for high-level and rising-edge sources alike."},
    {"id": "IRQ-PRIORITY", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "`irq_id` is the lowest-numbered source whose `PENDING` and `ENABLE` bits are both set, so source 0 has the highest priority, and it is 0 while `irq` is low."},
    {"id": "IRQ-CLAIM", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LATENCY", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-PARAM-SWEEP", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_param_sweep", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"], "rationale": "Run at N=2, N=8 and N=32. Write all ones to ENABLE, MODE and PENDING, and drive all src bits high. Check that bits N and up read 0 and that bits 0 to N-1 behave per spec."},
    {"id": "T-RESET", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_reset", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET"], "rationale": "Load nonzero ENABLE, MODE and PENDING, and hold edge sources high. Assert rst_n low for one edge. Check that all three registers read 0 and that irq is low. Release reset with an edge source still high and check that PENDING is set at the first edge (remembered level was cleared to 0)."},
    {"id": "A-RESET", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_reset_clears", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET"], "rationale": "If rst_n was low at the previous edge, then ENABLE, MODE and PENDING are zero."},
    {"id": "T-REG-RW", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_reg_rw", "proves": ["IRQ-REG-RW", "IRQ-PARAM"], "rationale": "Write walking-ones, all-ones and random patterns to ENABLE and MODE. Read them back and compare against wdata masked to bits N-1 to 0."},
    {"id": "T-READ", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_read_side_effect_free", "proves": ["IRQ-READ"], "rationale": "With we low, change addr between edges and sample rdata in the same cycle against the model. Read every register repeatedly and check that no register changes."},
    {"id": "A-READ", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_rdata_comb", "proves": ["IRQ-READ"], "rationale": "rdata always equals the register selected by addr, compared combinationally. When we is low and no src activity occurs, the registers hold their values."},
    {"id": "T-LEVEL", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_level_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL"], "rationale": "With MODE=0, hold a source high, clear PENDING via W1C and check that it is set again at the next edge. Drive the source low and check that the bit stays cleared after a clear."},
    {"id": "T-EDGE", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_edge_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-EDGE"], "rationale": "With MODE=1, raise a source and check that PENDING is set once. Clear it while the input is still held high and check that it stays cleared. Lower and raise the input again and check that it is set again."},
    {"id": "A-EDGE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_edge_set_once", "proves": ["IRQ-EDGE", "IRQ-LEVEL"], "rationale": "The next PENDING bit for source i is set if and only if the old bit was held, or it was detected (level: src high; edge: src high and previously low), less any clear. Checked per source against MODE."},
    {"id": "T-DETECT-DISABLED", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_detect_disabled", "proves": ["IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "IRQ-MASK"], "rationale": "With ENABLE=0, trigger level and edge sources. Check that the PENDING bits are set and irq stays low. Then enable and check that irq rises."},
    {"id": "T-W1C", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_pending_w1c", "proves": ["IRQ-W1C"], "rationale": "Set several PENDING bits, write a mixed mask, and check that only the bits written 1 clear. Write ones to clear bits with no source active and check that no bit is set."},
    {"id": "T-ACK", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_claim_ack", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "With several bits pending, write each id in turn to CLAIM and check that only that bit clears. Write ids N to 31 and check that nothing changes. Upper wdata bits are randomised to confirm only bits 4 to 0 are used."},
    {"id": "T-SET-WINS", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_set_wins", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Acknowledge and W1C-clear a high-level source whose input is still high, and check that it stays pending. Do the same for an edge source on the edge where it rises, and check that it stays pending."},
    {"id": "A-SET-WINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_set_wins", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-W1C", "IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "If a source is detected at an edge, its PENDING bit is 1 after that edge regardless of any concurrent PENDING or CLAIM write. A write never sets an undetected bit."},
    {"id": "A-MASK", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_mask", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "irq equals the OR of PENDING AND ENABLE, checked combinationally at all times."},
    {"id": "T-PRIORITY", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_priority", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY"], "rationale": "Use random PENDING and ENABLE combinations. Check that irq_id is the lowest set bit of PENDING AND ENABLE, and is 0 when none is set. Acknowledge in order and check that irq_id steps to the next source."},
    {"id": "A-PRIORITY", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_id_priority", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "irq_id equals the lowest-index set bit of PENDING AND ENABLE, or 0 if there is none, checked combinationally."},
    {"id": "T-CLAIM", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_claim_read", "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM"], "rationale": "Read CLAIM with irq low and with irq high for several ids. Check that bit 31 equals irq, bits 4 to 0 equal irq_id, and all other bits are zero."},
    {"id": "T-LATENCY", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_irq_latency", "proves": ["IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "Enable a source and trigger it. Check that irq and irq_id change in the cycle after the detecting edge with no extra register stage. Write ENABLE and check that irq responds in the same cycle as the register update."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===
